title: Canonical pullback and scalar change of whole quotient systems
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and an embedding $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For the small pro-etale site of every scheme $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the ringed sequence site with its actual positive quotient rings and quotient-linear transitions [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define the direct image of quotient systems by sectionwise base change and the canonical constant coefficient ring map. Define inverse image as its left adjoint and its exact derived functor. Define scalar change by the universal cochain-normalized derived change of rings for the map of quotient coefficient sheaves [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Define the composition comparison by the mate of the fibre-product-pasting map on direct images [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], the identity comparison by the inverse-image unit formula, and the scalar/pullback and scalar-composition comparisons by their tensor-generator formulas on the entire quotient diagram, before taking a limit. More explicitly, write $\gamma_f(x)$ for the ordinary inverse-image adjunction unit on a section at $(n,U)$. The scalar/pullback map sends $1\otimes\gamma_f(x)$ to $\gamma_f(1\otimes x)$. For $E\xrightarrow{\iota}L\xrightarrow{j}M$ the scalar associator sends $c\otimes(b\otimes x)$ to $c\,j(b)\otimes x$, and identity scalar change sends $s\otimes x$ to $sx$. The composition map is the inverse-image mate of the direct-image map induced by canonical fibre-product pasting. These formulas are natural in vertical site restrictions and horizontal quotient maps; derived comparisons are their localizations on K-flat complexes, using the universal cochain change-of-rings counits.

proof.text: Specialize AmbientPullbackTensor.baseContinuous to none. Its base functor and vertical sequence topology are definitionally the specified ones.
Specialize AmbientPullbackTensor.ringComponent_naturality to none; its ring components are the prescribed constant-section maps on the actual sequence site.

For integralComparisonSequenceScalar_naturality, apply functorial constant sheafification to integralScalarQuotientMap_transition from [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined]. NatTrans.ofOpSequence assembles the scalar inclusions into a natural transformation of coefficient sequences. Uncurrying and the product-opposite equivalence give the required equality for every sequence-site arrow. This step is proved in Lean.
Specialize AmbientPullbackTensor.pushRightAdjoint to none. The specified direct image is definitionally this sectionwise pushforward.

Specialize AmbientPullbackTensor.pullExact to none. The coefficient ring, direct image and chosen left adjoint are definitionally the same, giving additive finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation.

Specialize the existing ambient pushComp_existsUnique and pushId_existsUnique to none. Their chosen isomorphisms have uniquely specified section formulas, so using their inverses does not choose arbitrary data. Restricting a module presheaf along an isomorphism and its inverse is the identity. This converts the recorded inverse restriction into exactly the required fibre-product-pasting section formula. Take conjugateIsoEquiv under the actual composite adjunctions; its injectivity and sectionwise equality give uniqueness. The identity case uses unit_conjugateEquiv_symm and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence. The inverse section formulas are proved on the ambient site before specializing, avoiding concrete functor unfolding.

For scalar/pullback, use the normalized ordinary tensor/restriction adjunction. Naturality of constant sheafification in the scalar ring makes scalar restriction commute with direct image, by the identity on every section. Its adjunction mate is the ordinary comparison. The mate equation evaluates to the two displayed unit tensors; injectivity of the composite Hom correspondence proves uniqueness. For scalar composition and identity, prove the actual quotient ring maps compose and preserve identity by quotient induction, then apply systemScalarModelComposition_tmul and systemScalarModelUnit_tmul. Normalized tensor generators detect equality. The four complete generic scalar proofs and the fixed-model normalized ordinary adjunction are extracted to separate proved modules; concrete specializations apply them directly. Fixed-model scalar composition and identity are also proved before concrete specialization, avoiding concrete model equality rewrites.

For the derived scalar/pullback comparison, use resolvingRepresentativesFullyFaithfulWhiskering for the full subcategory of K-flat complexes. Its product version gives unary fully faithful whiskering by restriction along the diagonal. The two universal scalar counits and the ordinary comparison give alpha and beta into the same cochain tensor functor. On flat-term K-flat inputs beta is invertible by computes. Obtain closed tensor models from ringedDerived_closed_symmetric_monoidal and specialize the Normalized consequence of ambient tensorData_existsUnique to none; this proves pullback preserves flat-term K-flat representatives, so alpha is invertible there too. This extracts only a proposition inside the theorem proof. Resolve an arbitrary K-flat complex by a flat-term K-flat one; naturality and quasi-isomorphism inversion imply alpha is invertible on it. Their ratio descends uniquely along fully faithful whiskering, giving exactly the stated normalization on every K-flat representative. The complete K-flat restriction and normalized derived comparison are extracted as generic proved lemmas. Assemble the resolving witness with explicit flatness and good-representative proofs.
